description: This file is a PHP class 'Authorize' within the OpenCart admin controller namespace, managing user authorization and MFA workflows including token validation, reset, unlock, and sending authorization codes.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class handling multi-factor authentication and authorization procedures for admin users.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the authorization page, generating tokens if needed, and setting up redirect data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending of verification codes via email, with redirection based on token validation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates submitted authorization code, updates authorization status, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Provides the form to reset authorization when attempts are exhausted.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms authorization reset request by generating a reset token.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles user unlocking process by verifying email and code, resetting authorizations, and logging out.
